items.risk: utoipa-swagger-ui egress 403 (#2966) renders api-server structurally unbuildable in the cloud runner — every backend-touching dispatcher task is CLOUD-BUILD-BLOCKED, including all 3 open cross-tenant IDOR retries (#2944/#2945/#2946). Security fixes are not landing because the toolchain can't compile, not because the fix is hard
items.mitigation: Vendor swagger-ui assets locally OR allowlist the egress target OR cache the dist in the sandbox base image — any of three. Blocks: all backend security PRs plus #2559 / #2555 accounting trio
items.trigger: Any dispatcher run with claimable<=10 AND >=2 open blocked-on-#2966 items

items.risk: Cross-tenant IDOR #2946 (portfolio_analytics property metrics computed org_id then discarded) is on retry 2/2 and still open — a tier-1 security defect that has survived two implementer attempts; a successful exploit returns per-property metrics across org boundaries
items.mitigation: Prioritize #2966 unblock; if infra slips, land #2946 fix locally and push a reviewed PR by hand; add a hand-written cross-tenant repro test as part of the fix PR so regression surfaces
items.trigger: retry 2/2 failing without a merged PR; or dispatcher record of 3+ failed-no-pr cycles

items.risk: @ppt/api-client has triplicated auth-header + MFA-retry logic across fetch primitives (gdprClient, paymentMatching, remaining consumers) — surfaced by post-merge review of PR #3004 and tracked as #3006. Three copies will drift (one will forget to attach MFA-retry on a 403; one will send a stale token; one will log the token). Classic security-overtones refactor target
items.mitigation: Collapse into a single shared `authenticatedFetchJson` primitive; add a biome rule to forbid new fetch primitives that do not import from the shared module
items.trigger: Any new PR introducing a 4th auth-header path, OR an MFA regression caught post-merge

items.risk: Accounting MVP-loop trio (#2555 / #2558 / #2559) has been sitting at 64d with no reviewer engagement — dispatcher stack is still starving on reviewer capacity, not implementer capacity. Risk is now aging past the 'review by October' commitment captured in the sprint retro
items.mitigation: Explicit reviewer slot for the trio next 24h; document reviewer-slot rotation policy for large-scope feature PRs

items.risk: Layout publish webhook lacks timestamp/replay protection (#2485) — a captured legitimate publish can be replayed to overwrite a newer layout
items.mitigation: Fix #2485 (add nonce+timestamp+HMAC parity with esignature webhook); track integration test in action-list

items.risk: Mobile LAYOUT_CACHE_KEY is not tenant-scoped and survives logout (#2486) — user A's layout can leak to user B on shared device or org-switch
items.mitigation: Fix #2486 (namespace cache key by tenant_id + purge on logout); add regression test in QA action-list

items.risk: add_evidence dispute sub-resource remains cross-tenant-writable until PR #2490 lands (#2483) — PR #2450 fixed 5 handlers but missed the sub-route
items.mitigation: Land PR #2490 promptly; add subroute-authz regression as part of ongoing IDOR sweep pattern

items.risk: Announcement cross-tenant fan-out guard is tested only via a pure-Rust re-model, not the real SQL (#2484) — the SQL predicate could regress without the test catching it
items.mitigation: Replace pure-Rust model test with sqlx integration test that exercises the actual RLS policy

items.risk: Multiple shipped MVP features (Epic 6, 10A, 10B, 80, 84) lack KPI instrumentation — product/business decisions run blind
items.mitigation: Sequence pm-data KPI-definition tasks; establish minimum-analytics DoD for future stories

items.risk: Append-only support_tooling_events + support-data audit trail have ON DELETE RESTRICT but no TTL — long-term storage/GDPR compliance risk
items.mitigation: Publish retention policy; if GDPR-in-scope, add lifecycle policy for personal-data-containing events

items.risk: FaultStatusCount metric (support-data) diverges from owner/portfolio fault KPIs — dashboards will disagree with each other
items.mitigation: Land single-source-of-truth metric definitions in shared module; deprecate duplicates

items.risk: Webhook handlers across integrations (booking, airbnb, esignature, layout) lack consistent hardening — #2485 shows layout has no replay guard; unknown parity elsewhere
items.mitigation: Cross-cutting audit action-list item integrations-webhook-hardening-audit-2026-07-23

items.risk: PR #2571 (DELETE-by-file-key) landed with a same-org reference-check gap (#2573) — an active same-org file key can be deleted out from under a live document row
items.mitigation: Land a reference-count guard + integration test before any client wires the endpoint

items.risk: PR #2568 CSRF state fix is non-functional (#2574) — SsoStateStore.mint() has no call site so every reality://sso callback is rejected
items.mitigation: Wire mint() at the SSO deep-link entry point; add integration test for the happy-path SSO callback

items.risk: Dispute KPI endpoint (#2572 → #2575) is quarantined-test-only in main; a shape regression could ship undetected until reporting starts consuming it
items.mitigation: Un-quarantine the KPIs test; add window_start <= window_end validation; add a second test asserting the reporting-consumer contract

items.risk: backend/servers/api-server/src/routes/voice_webhooks.rs is on its 3rd hotspot window running; PR #2838 centralized token encryption but scheduler/OAuth-refresh/token-vend paths still cluster — repeated micro-fixes without a structural split are a leading indicator of a latent design defect
items.mitigation: Draft a refactor plan (extract token-mgmt / webhook-handlers / scheduler-jobs into 3 modules) before the next voice-related feature request

items.risk: 3 mobile-rn PRs fixed defects that eslint-plugin-react-hooks + a no-hardcoded-strings rule would catch statically — every future mobile-rn PR risks reintroducing them
items.mitigation: Adopt eslint-plugin-react-hooks + i18next-hardcoded-strings ESLint config in frontend/apps/mobile; gate CI on it

items.risk: Buffer starvation becomes chronic — every new mobile-native/KMP finding adds an unclaimable item to the cloud dispatcher's pool, now compounded by #2966 forcing claimable=9/72
items.mitigation: Fix issue #2652 (AGP/Gradle egress in cloud sandbox) + issue #2966 (swagger-ui egress) or split action-list into cloud + local buckets
items.trigger: 3+ consecutive dispatcher runs with claimable<=15 and open>=5 blocked-infra items

items.risk: `research-land.yml` is the only path routine commits reach `dev` from cloud session branches. A silent workflow break would let `.research/` commits accumulate on session branches without landing
items.mitigation: Add alert if `dev` HEAD has no research commit for >36h (mirrors routine's Phase 1 stale-routine check)
items.trigger: gap of 36h+ between routine commits on `dev`

items.risk: cargo-deny advisories FAILED on dev HEAD: RUSTSEC-2026-0368 / RUSTSEC-2026-0369 on zip 8.6.0 pulled transitively via rust_xlsxwriter (#3124). Every backend PR merge is now gated on this since the advisory gate is required. Compounds with #2966 (swagger-ui egress) that already blocks builds — now builds green PRs cannot merge either.
items.mitigation: Either bump rust_xlsxwriter to a version with safe zip transitive dep, or add a bounded cargo-deny exception for RUSTSEC-2026-0368/0369 with a deadline captured in dispatcher backlog and surfaced in CI gate description
items.trigger: cargo-deny advisories failing on dev at any point beyond 24h after advisory publication

items.risk: External-dependency drift surface: cargo-deny can veto every backend merge on any new RUSTSEC advisory landing on a transitive dep (today: rust_xlsxwriter → zip 8.6.0 → RUSTSEC-2026-0368/0369). Integration velocity collapses to zero on advisory bursts; no SLA on how fast exceptions get triaged.
items.mitigation: Introduce a bounded cargo-deny exception window with deadline tracked in dispatcher backlog; add CI gate description text that links the exception policy and names the current triage owner
items.trigger: Any cargo-deny advisory failure that is not resolved within 24h

items.risk: PR #3122 touched @ppt/api-client compliance types (AML flags). If api-validation.yml did not regenerate cleanly against the typespec snapshot, downstream frontends could silently diverge on nullable flag defaults
items.mitigation: Spot-check api-validation.yml on PR #3122; if the generated client bump was not part of the merge, open a follow-up to regenerate

items.risk: violations add_evidence sub-route is ungated (#3164) — allows any authenticated user (incl. cross-tenant) to attach evidence to any violation; same shape as the dispute add_evidence sub-route gap (#2483) a year ago, suggesting the add_evidence pattern is systemically under-tested
items.mitigation: Add tenant-scoped authz guard to violations add_evidence; add cross-tenant integration test (follow community_cross_tenant_idor_tests.rs pattern); sweep for other add_evidence/add_* sub-routes with the same gap
items.trigger: Any violations IDOR exploit reported, OR a 2nd add_evidence-shaped gap found in a different resource

items.risk: Issue #3168 — 3 new RUSTSEC advisories on dev gate every backend PR merge; this is the second cargo-deny gate in a month (#3124 cleared 2026-10-19). Dependency hygiene is becoming a recurring merge-queue tax
items.mitigation: Resolve #3168 (bump offending crate(s) or bounded exception); schedule a quarterly cargo-tree review of transitive deps with known-flaky lineage (zip/xlsxwriter were last month's culprit — look for recurrence)
items.trigger: Any dispatcher run reporting cargo-deny FAILED or claimable<=10 while backend queue is non-empty

items.risk: Three independent frontend code-review findings in 7 days reveal mobile-rn / reality-web have 'wire-the-button-but-not-the-POST' bugs (ReportFault setTimeout, reality-web /sell no-persist, VoteDetail ranked ballot) — chronic class suggests the mobile/web UI slices ship without an end-to-end integration smoke
items.mitigation: Add a per-screen e2e-smoke gate: for every form with a Submit button, a MSW/Mirage mock asserts the POST is sent with the collected payload; block merge if the submit emits no network call
items.trigger: A third user-facing form-submit regression lands without this gate

items.risk: pm-frontend rotation has been stale 83 days (last run 2026-08-06) while the backlog accumulated 12 frontend/mobile code-review items — the daily rotation cadence is skewing toward backend-heavy weeks because sprint velocity is backend-driven, leaving UI-surface findings uncoordinated
items.mitigation: Add a staleness-bias to pm_cursor rotation: when any role is >60 days stale, prefer it over the current index. Alternately, run full-rotation sweeps on 10-day cadence instead of relying on daily rotation only
items.trigger: Any pm-* role crosses 90 days stale

items.risk: Dispatcher pipeline at 0-claimed/0-merged for ~10 consecutive runs (until this runs burst of pre-existing relands); planner buffer at 6/72 claimable; fresh non-mobile-native vectors are not being generated fast enough to keep 3 implementers fed at 12 runs/day
items.mitigation: Phase 3 priority: promote non-mobile-native code-review-finding vectors this run; escalate #3357 to operator; monitor dispatcher claim rate over next 48h

items.risk: Cloud research-routine scheduler is drifting silently — last_run_iso=2026-11-09 vs today 2026-11-13 (4-day lag) with no error surfaced. Dispatcher stayed productive, but routine state advances fell behind.
items.mitigation: Add a hard lag-floor check in Phase 1 that raises an alert on >48h lag; audit the cloud cron invocation path for silent failures.

items.risk: 9 Dependabot PRs open simultaneously (incl. major bumps vitest 4→5, jsonwebtoken 10→11, utoipa-swagger-ui 9→10). Delayed review compounds compatibility risk and pulls the auto-approve window further from upstream.
items.mitigation: Human-gate review within 72h for majors; auto-approve minor/patch groups once CI green; set a WIP cap on open Dependabot PRs.

items.risk: Further RLS or owner-check gaps remain in delegation-adjacent routes, enabling cross-tenant access
items.mitigation: Sibling-path audit and negative authz tests, as in next_actions

items.risk: Raw DB or internal error leakage in API responses (#3560 pattern) elsewhere
items.mitigation: Central error-mapping review of routes that return raw errors

items.risk: Mobile cross-user deep-link state on shared devices
items.mitigation: Reset the singleton on logout or user switch

items.risk: Backend security fixes cannot compile in the cloud runner (#2966), so cross-tenant IDOR fixes are delayed
items.mitigation: Vendor or cache the swagger-ui assets, or allowlist the egress target

items.risk: 18 open PRs, with 9 Dependabot majors stacking, increase merge-conflict and release risk
items.mitigation: Batch-merge Dependabot PRs after the build is unblocked

items.risk: Routine lag and stale management artifacts (project-state and coverage are 3 days old) lead to decisions on out-of-date data
items.mitigation: Run a scan now and keep the cursor rotation

items.mitigation: Ship the LEFT JOIN fix with a regression test first

items.risk: Abandoned digests exist only as a tracing::error! line, so a log-pipeline loss or restart at the boundary tick makes them invisible permanently.
items.mitigation: Add an abandoned_at terminal state

items.risk: Backend security and data fixes (#3583, digest fixes, #3427) cannot compile in the cloud runner while swagger-ui egress (#2966) is unresolved, so verification relies on CI alone.
items.mitigation: Prioritize the egress fix (pm-devops); keep backend PRs small and CI-gated

items.risk: Warn-only lint gates on mobile (#3566) may never be promoted, which is what #3584 flags.
items.mitigation: Set a dated promotion criterion

items.risk: Digest engagement and re-activation KPIs are biased, because the cohort with no live refresh token (the long-tail inactive users) is excluded without any record
items.mitigation: LEFT JOIN fix, then backfill the cohort size and report it as excluded_by_filter

items.risk: Abandoned digests are visible only in logs, so after log loss or a restart the failure rate is under-reported and cannot be audited
items.mitigation: Add abandoned_at and alert on count

items.risk: A leaked session advisory lock can make the sweep skip runs silently, creating unreported gaps in digest delivery data
items.mitigation: Detach or close the connection on release error; emit a sweep-skipped counter

items.risk: Mobile has no evident analytics layer, so mobile fault-report attempt and conversion funnels cannot be measured and web and mobile metric definitions may diverge
items.mitigation: Agree one event catalogue and a shared event schema

items.risk: Events added late to features that have already shipped have no baseline, so before/after comparisons are weak
items.mitigation: Make events part of the story definition of done

items.risk: Additive `slug` field on reality-server /listings response may not propagate to generated TS/Kotlin/iOS clients. Clients could keep building links from UUID or fail strict decoding if non-optional.
items.mitigation: Run spec/client regen in CI; keep field additive; clients tolerant of unknown fields

items.mitigation: Echo effective limit; document offset/limit semantics in spec

items.risk: Error sanitization on voice OAuth account linking (#3621) could break voice platform linking if sanitized message/status deviates from Alexa/Google expectations.
items.mitigation: Contract test on error shape; alert on `voice OAuth upstream call failed` log line

items.risk: cargo-deny advisory gate (#3604) can block all backend merges; recurring pattern; cargo-deny is non-required so regressions could go unnoticed.
items.mitigation: Bounded exception window with owner + deadline; surface triage owner in CI gate description

items.risk: Churn hotspots (listings.rs, compliance.rs) receive contract-adjacent edits without evidence that OpenAPI/TypeSpec is updated in the same PRs — spec drift likely.

items.risk: Three recent/open PRs (#3617, #3628 + merged #3609/#3616) touch reality-server listings.rs (churn hotspot); merge conflicts and duplicated slug/region logic are likely.
items.mitigation: Sequence merges; rebase #3617 and #3628 on current dev; one reviewer pass over listings.rs

items.risk: Mobile no-hardcoded-strings lint gate flips from warn to error on 2026-12-01 — could turn CI red for mobile PRs.
items.mitigation: Burn down i18n backlog before the date, or extend the window

items.risk: Repeated churn in push_fanout.rs and voice_webhooks.rs points to missing module boundaries. Review follow-ups keep re-touching the same files, which raises merge-conflict and regression risk and feeds the dispatcher stall.
items.mitigation: Decompose the files, and enforce CODEOWNERS or a single-writer rule per hot file in the dispatcher.

items.risk: Dispatcher stall (#3357): with 9 PRs dep-blocked, 3 approved PRs conflicting, and 41/50 of the buffer used, the pipeline can deadlock. Throughput then drops while review debt accumulates.
items.mitigation: Add conflict-aware scheduling, serialize PRs that touch hot files, and let a human resolve non-mechanical conflicts.

items.mitigation: Isolate verification code into a small, fully tested module, and add replay and idempotency tests.

items.risk: Sprint tracking is stale: it is dated 2025-12 with a 2026-10 reconcile, and nothing is in-progress. Planning and coverage reporting cannot detect real drift, and the 'done' claims rest on verify notes rather than on current CI.

items.risk: Dispatcher stall (#3357) leaves approved PRs unmerged and review debt growing (stalled-review #3380 8d)

items.trigger: Any new mobile-native backlog item lands without a jvmTest contract assertion

items.trigger: #3357 still open after the next merge window OR claimable drops below 36 again
